title: Isiqalekiso Sesivuno Esininzi
intro: Kwilizwe lamandulo, umphefumlo othile wawumi phakathi kwezona zizityebi kuluntu lwabo. Iintsikelelo zomhlaba zaziphindwe kabini kubo kwiminyaka elandelelanayo, isivuno esiphindwe kabini esasifanele ukuba sizalisa iintliziyo zabo ngombulelo. Kodwa xa kwafika intlekele kwaye yonke into ababenayo yathathwa ngobusuku obunye, impendulo yabo yatyhila uhlobo lokwenyani lomphefumlo wabo. Ungayifumana na into yokuba ngubani lo mntu ibali lakhe lisisilumkiso malunga nokungakholelwa kwiintsikelelo zika-Allah?
clues: Ndandiphakathi kwabantu abanethamsanqa elikhulu kulo lonke ilizwe, ndisikelelwe ngezinto ezininzi.
Isivuno sifike kabini kum kwiminyaka emibini, kodwa intliziyo yam ayizange ibulele iNkosi yam.
Ndandinegadi entle enezidiliya, iminquma, nemithi yesundu—ubungqina bobubele buka-Allah.
Xa igadi yam yatshatyalaliswayo, ndema emanxiweni ayo izandla zam zolulelwe ezulwini, ndiqalekisa ikamva lam.
Ndakhanyela ukuba uAllah wayenokubangela ilahleko enjalo, nangona ndandizityumza izandla zam ngenxa yokuphelelwa lithemba.
Isohlwayo sam asikokulahlekelwa yigadi yam nje kuphela, kodwa kukushiya ndingenakunceda nto emanxuweni ayo, ndingakwazi nokubiza nabani na oncedisayo.
